court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before S.M. Subramaniam and K. Surender, JJ.)
respondents: Government of Tamilnadu, Rep. by its Secretary and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. U.M. Ravichandran Spl. Govt. Pleader for R 1 to R 3 & R 6
prayer: Prayer: To review the order passed in WA No. 1610 of 2025 dated 20-6-2025 and allow the Writ appeal as prayed for.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S.M. Subramaniam, J.:— Review Application has been instituted, seeking review of the order of this Court dated 10-7-2018 passed in W.A. No. 1610 of 2025.

2. The learned Single Judge dismissed the writ proceedings mainly on the ground of delay and laches and found that there was no negligence on the part of Authorities. Reiterating the said ground, Writ appellate court also rejected the appeal.

3. Re-adjudication of merits in a review proceedings is impermissible. The scope of Review Application cannot be expanded for the purpose of adjudication of grounds on merits. The Review Applicant has not established any error apparent warranting interference by this Court, by exercise of powers of review jurisdiction.

Consequently, the present Review Application stands dismissed. No costs.
